sourceExecution: supportPosition uses coordinate median of mobile non-incapacitated tracked dismounts, falling back to all on-foot members only if none are mobile. A50% centre blend applies when the prior centre is within100m. It picks a real nearest soldier for traces, but the leader does not control centre/direction. Support target lies15m(default,min12) short of the infantry body along vehicle-to-centre bearing. Water and normalZ<0.55 refuse.

findOverwatchPosition tests5rear rings*9angles=45candidates, behind the infantry median relative to a live threat,>=10m from friendly infantry, dry/slope/native object clearance and2D friendly path corridor, then current target LOS from hypothetical2.5m height. It sorts travel/radius/offset score.

updateSupport queries friendly infantry250m around vehicle, chooses nearest supplied current/shared threat, caches success AND failure for15s or15m body motion/changed threat identity. It may fall back to two rear corners, uses10m immediate run-over zone and repeated straight-segment tests, commands hold or at3s intervals forceSpeed+driver doMove. Default pace12/catchup30kmh, near25m infantry cap8,12m arrival hold. holdVehicle writes forceSpeed0.

sourceTrace: registerJob binds actual non-operator AI passengers to a vehicle and snapshots passenger groups, forced speed, unload policy and operating seats. updateJob refreshes the manifest in transit; rejects player takeover and no living infantry, delegates dismount/disabled/remount work. ENGAGING and FOOT_ESCORT call updateSupport; FOOT_ESCORT returns to transit only after all tracked infantry are aboard. Same-side group changes can be joined back to captured groups; do not copy this authority assumption.

releaseJob marks released and relinquishes source movement/locks, sends passenger RELEASE/ABANDON and crew STATIC_UNLOCK, restores unload/immobile policy, removes vehicle EHs and job registry. It calls releaseVehicle. Delegated remote/deferred passenger/crew writers need their own token/lifetime audit; deleting a job does not establish acknowledgement.

releaseVehicle restores captured forced speed if source marks it controlled, stop-false/follows driver and actual leader, then can replay Battle Lines destination or saved MOVE leg after the mission pointer advanced. confirmedFindings: postInit registers PDTB_passengerCommand as a direct call to commandPassengerLocal. commandPassenger returns true after local call/targetEvent without consuming receiver result or owner acknowledgement.

commandPassengerLocal gates only null/local/player before switch; it does not generally revalidate live vehicle job, token, native route or original group. applyPassengerAILocal can refuse a stale unlock token, but command callers ignore that result and continue unassigning/boarding/releasing.

CREW_RESEAT changes vehicle policy and assign/moveIn seat. BOARD_FORCE uses moveInCargo. DISPERSE/BOARD_RESCUE/BOARD_HAILMARY use setPos/velocity/direction or hide/reveal shortcuts. These are excluded from CBE natural movement, not implementations to reproduce.

deferredCrewRetain validates vehicle job ID, registry row, living occupants and safety before dispatch. A remote delivery may occur after release; command receiver has no corresponding general admission guard. Source release removes its job/EHs without queued-command acknowledgements.

setMovementOwner restores captured group flags and dispatches RELEASEMOVE to marked actors, then clears active boarding array. This is not proof the receiver has stopped. Local receiver RELEASEMOVE unassigns and follows regardless of current native task identity.

updateRouteResume can switch to SAVED after current waypoint advances, reissue old doMove, and declare handback from speed>2, moveToCompleted or40m arrival. Early follow resets repeat every2s;45s no-progress ends with follow. Neither returned true nor group markers prove native writer retirement.
